Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Business Analyst role at Knock. The posting centers on reporting that people can trust: dashboards in Tableau, clean and well-defined data, and automation that replaces manual steps. I want to build that kind of reporting for a lending business.

At AMG Family Dental in Belmont, MA, I have been Financial Manager since August 2023, directing financial operations for a practice serving more than 1,000 patients a year. Each month I prepare budget-vs-actual variance analysis and KPI reports for ownership, so I have seen what happens when a metric is defined loosely and two people read it differently. By improving financial reporting and reconciliation, I identified and recovered more than $500K in annual revenue and reduced A/R aging by 10%. Those results came from getting the data right first and the analysis second.

My technical skills line up with what you list. I work in SQL, Python (Pandas and NumPy), R, Tableau and advanced Excel, and I earned my M.A. in International Economics & Finance (STEM) at Brandeis. At Northrop Grumman I audited more than 100 financial models for accuracy and internal controls, which taught me to document definitions and check inputs before trusting an output. I have also researched machine learning and NLP tools as an AI Research Intern at FYND K.K. in Tokyo, and I am comfortable with the automation side of the role.

Working with senior analysts to standardize data across systems is the kind of structured, learn-fast environment I am looking for. I am a U.S. citizen, available immediately, and ready to work remotely.

Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Alexander Airapetian
